notes: One of the big three. What a marvel of human invention. Mango shines through with strawberry aftertaste
body:
I am not sure if ghost will ever top this one. For a very long time I thought their peak would be Faze pop ('Merica flavor) or orange cream. They were already one of my most consistent go-tos. I just wish this flavor was more readily available either online or in stores.

Overall taste: Layered. I don't know how they do it. A slightly viscious taste of sweet and slightly sour mango hits you first, like you're drinking a mango lassi with starbursts. And slowly there is a nice and smooth gradient to a nice strawberry flavor that's just enhanced by carbonation. Best served very chilled. I've even mixed this with ice, frozen it and am looking for more ways to eat it.

Overall experience: This is what happiness feels like. This may not have changed your life as it did mine, but crack one open on a summer road trip or gym visit and you'll have a great time.
name: Strawbango
